title: Windows Active Directory RCE and DoS Vulnerabilities Put Windows Systems at Risk
content_md: Microsoft disclosed two Windows Active Directory vulnerabilities on November 10, 2026, exposing affected systems to remote code execution and denial of service. Tracked as CVE-2026-119948 and CVE-2026-105559, both carry an Important severity rating. Their attack vectors require low privileges and no user interaction, highlighting the potential consequences of compromised accounts within enterprise environments.
